title: Generic finite pushforward is constructible
statement: Let $S$ be an integral Noetherian affine scheme, let $g:Z\to S$ be finite, and let $E$ be a constructible abelian etale sheaf on $Z$. There is a dense open $S^\circ\subset S$ on which the direct image $g_*E$ is lisse.

proof.text: Write S=Spec A with A a Noetherian domain and fraction field K. Since a finite algebra is integral by [pqf-lem-finite-integral-lft], lying over shows that finite morphisms are closed; this permits all subsequent shrinkings of S.

Replace Z by its reduction. The nilpotent immersion is a universal homeomorphism, so [thm-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-invariance] identifies the etale sites and transports E. By [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-finite-components], Z has finitely many irreducible components. The generic points of the finite fibre over (0) are precisely the generic points of components dominating S. If there are none, the closed image g(Z) misses the generic point and g_*E is zero on a dense open.

For each component dominating S, apply [lem-weil-pbc-irreducible-lisse-strata] to the constructible sheaf E. The stratum containing its generic point contains an open neighbourhood of that point in the component; remove the other components and intersect the finitely many resulting neighbourhoods. Their union W is open in the reduced Z, contains the generic fibre, and E is lisse on W. The closed set g(Z\setminus W) misses the generic point, so after replacing S by a nonempty principal open in its complement, E is lisse on all of Z.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-generic-finite-algebra-splitting] to B=Γ(Z,O_Z). After a further dense shrinking and a finite surjective etale cover S'=Spec A'→S, the reduction of Z×_S S' is a finite disjoint union of schemes Spec D_j, each finite, surjective and universally homeomorphic to S'. The nilpotent thickening is again removed using [thm-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-invariance].

For each factor $u_j:\operatorname{Spec}(D_j)\to S'$ the universal-homeomorphism equivalence [thm-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-invariance] identifies the pullback of $E$ with a finite locally constant sheaf on $S'$ and identifies its direct image $u_{j*}$ with that sheaf. The direct image from the finite disjoint union is therefore a finite product of finite locally constant sheaves, hence lisse (refine their finitely many trivializing etale covers). The finite exchange isomorphism [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-exchange] identifies this sheaf with the pullback of $g_*E$ over the shrunken $S$.
Because S'→S is etale and surjective, a trivializing etale cover of the pullback descends to a trivializing etale cover of S. Hence g_*E is lisse on the chosen dense open.
